modeHints.ask: Read only. Claude can read this folder and Hub, and cannot change anything or run commands.
modeHints.plan: Read only, and ends in a proposed plan for you to review. It cannot change anything or run commands.
modeHints.execute: Claude reads and edits inside this folder freely. Delete, commit, push, deploy, branch, worktree and docker wait for your approval, as does any command you have not allowed.

failures.signed_out: Claude is signed out on this device. Run claude auth login there, then try again.
failures.rate_limited: The usage limit is reached. It resets at the time shown.
failures.billing: Claude reports a billing problem on this account.
failures.overloaded: Claude is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
failures.version_out_of_range: This device's Claude Code is outside the versions Hub has tested. Use Open in VS Code until Hub is updated.
failures.claude_missing: Claude Code was not found on this device.
failures.session_missing: Claude no longer has this conversation. Send again to start over from here.
failures.folder_not_allowed: That folder is not registered on this project.
failures.folder_missing: That folder does not exist on the device.
failures.device_offline: The device went offline during this turn.
failures.cut_off: Claude Code stopped before the turn ended.
failures.unknown: This turn failed, and Claude did not say why.

approvals.title: Waiting for your approval
approvals.expires: Denied automatically if nobody answers by {time}
